title: Adoption and the Spirit
definition: Adoption and the Spirit refers to the Spirit's ministry of assuring believers that they are God's children and helping them cry, 'Abba, Father.'
summary: The Spirit of adoption teaches believers to know God as Father through Christ.
christFocus: Jesus brings believers into sonship, and the Spirit bears witness that they belong to the Father.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Spirit does not merely give power for service; He brings believers into the lived reality of adoption. Through Him, they cry, 'Abba, Father.'

Adoption is secured by Christ and witnessed by the Spirit. Believers are no longer slaves to fear but children and heirs of God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people carry orphan-hearted fear, rejection, or insecurity. This doctrine matters because the Spirit teaches believers they are welcomed children in Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray to the Father through Christ with confidence. Ask the Spirit to heal false views of God and deepen your sense of belonging.
